parts: Golden and white female born on April 16, 2007. Shoulder height: 24,50 cm. Weith: 6,700 Kg.
Mother DNA identified with the Real Sociedad Canina de España.

After several long years of waiting, our most eagerly awaited and longed-for girl was finally born. From the cross of Nano with our Spanish Champion female Amistad Sincera, this little girl was born, and of course she has stayed with us. After years of waiting, time and dedication, our efforts have been rewarded with her.

Her structure and outline are true to her bloodlines and lineage. Extremely feminine, with a very expressive head, a deep, well-defined stop, large, full eyes and perfectly aligned teeth, with barely any undershot bite, a reverse scissor bite and a very short muzzle. Excellent front and rear angulation gives her outstanding movement, with powerful drive from every angle, a beautifully set neck of lovely length, a very straight back and a perfect tail set. Her coat's length and quality are incredible, very dense and with good texture.
We are very fortunate to have bred this little girl in our home.
Mother of our E, H, J and L litters. She is the mother of 4 of our champions.
